title: 後庄守護者：小吉的逆襲

h3.style: a vibrant 3D animated family feature film, stylized Pixar-like CG cartoon rendering, soft global illumination, saturated colors, smooth clean toon shading
h3.setting: Houzhuang Elementary School campus in Pingtung, Taiwan, as a 3D cartoon set
h3.soundscape: Outdoor school campus ambience with matching sound effects for the on-screen action.
h3.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.
constraints: Maintain the exact 3D cartoon animation style, vibrant toon shading, and stylized CG proportions of <Picture 1> in every single frame.
Every character keeps the exact same 3D cartoon design, colors, and proportions as in <Picture 1> from the first frame to the last frame.
Keep all surfaces clean, solid, and consistent with a stylized 3D animated family film.
Keep all character limbs, hands, and cardboard mecha parts solid and well-formed.

huang.name: 黃老師
huang.look: Teacher Huang, a 3D cartoon Taiwanese male elementary school teacher with short grey-black hair, round black-rimmed glasses, a friendly smile, a navy-blue T-shirt and black shorts
huang.h3_voice: a warm, cheerful middle-aged Taiwanese male teacher's voice, expressive and lively, natural Taiwanese Mandarin

xiaoji.name: 小吉
xiaoji.look: Xiaoji, a 3D cartoon robot built from yellow-orange corrugated cardboard boxes with black tape patches, a square box head with two tall thin black antennas, two large oval eyes that glow when active, a small round O-shaped mouth, a small silver cooling fan on its right shoulder, chunky boxy arms and legs; it can fold into a six-wheeled yellow cardboard bulldozer truck with a front blade
xiaoji.h3_voice: a bright, energetic young boy-robot voice, heroic and highly expressive, with a faint metallic ring

xiaoji_truck.name: 小吉
xiaoji_truck.look: Xiaoji in bulldozer truck mode, a 3D cartoon six-wheeled yellow-orange corrugated cardboard engineering truck with black tape patches, a wide front bulldozer scoop blade, six chunky black rubber wheels, and a boxy cab with two tall thin black antennas and two glowing oval eyes
xiaoji_truck.h3_voice: a bright, energetic young boy-robot voice, heroic and highly expressive, with a faint metallic ring

dahei.name: 大黑
dahei.look: Dahei, a giant 3D cartoon villain mecha made of jagged black and dark-grey armor blocks, glowing red eyes, a swirling purple energy core in the middle of its chest, purple lightning crackling around its body
dahei.h3_voice: a deep, booming, slow villain voice, menacing and gleeful, with a cruel rolling laugh

kids.name: 學生
kids.look: Houzhuang Elementary pupils, 3D cartoon Taiwanese children in school PE shirts colored red-and-yellow or blue-and-yellow, with shorts

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang keeps his right hand on Xiaoji's cardboard shoulder, leans in slightly and speaks with a proud, trusting smile, giving two firm pats on the shoulder and a small nod. Xiaoji's oval eyes light up bright orange, its box head tilts up toward the teacher, its antennas wobble, and it raises its right hand to its forehead in a crisp salute. Teacher Huang steps back half a step and gives a thumbs-up.
shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in from a medium shot.

line.text: 小吉，後庄國小就交給你了！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji straightens up among the cardboard piles, its eyes flash orange and it shouts the line eagerly. Right after, it folds down in one continuous transformation: its arms swing forward and lock into a wide front bulldozer blade, its legs fold back into six chunky black wheels, and its torso flattens into a truck bed. The finished yellow cardboard truck rolls forward half a meter and a small white puff of steam pops from its side.
shots.camera: The camera tracks sideways slowly at the robot's height.

line.text: 收到！紙箱工程卡車，出發！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the girl in the red-and-yellow shirt drops her plastic bottle into Xiaoji's chest box, picks up another one and drops it too, then bounces on her toes. The boy in the blue-and-yellow shirt pushes his bottle in, looks up at Xiaoji and waves both hands happily. Both children turn their heads toward each other and laugh. Xiaoji's eyes switch to glowing green, its shoulder fan spins faster, and it nods its box head twice while speaking proudly.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.

line.text: 只要確實分類，核心永遠滿格！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the dark purple storm clouds over the school sports field churn and swirl faster. A thick jagged bolt of purple lightning cracks down and strikes the pile of mixed garbage beside the track. The pile bursts with a purple flash, a tall column of black smoke rolls upward, and small pieces of trash and plastic bags are thrown across the red running track while the tree branches whip in the wind.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static wide shot on a tripod.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the giant villain Dahei rises out of the purple clouds and takes one heavy step forward. The purple core in its chest pulses brighter three times. It throws its head back and laughs, then clenches both huge fists and lifts them up beside its head while shouting the line with cruel glee. Purple lightning crackles across its black armor blocks and small rocks bounce on the ground with every movement.
shots.camera: The camera slowly tilts up from a low angle.

line.text: 哈哈！美味的髒亂！化成灰燼吧！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Dahei stretches its left arm toward the litter along the wet walkway. A river of black oily sludge, crushed lunch boxes and plastic cups is sucked along the ground toward its open palm in a swirling stream. The purple core in its chest spins and glows brighter, purple veins of light spread across its armor, and the pavement cracks open under the stream.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, little Xiaoji plants its feet in front of the giant Dahei, points at it and shouts the line with fierce determination, its eyes blazing orange. On the last word it jumps into a transformation: its arms swing forward and lock together into a big yellow bulldozer blade held like a shield, steam bursts from its joints, and it drops into a low battle stance. Dahei leans forward and glares with its red eyes.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static wide shot on a tripod.

line.text: 不准破壞後庄！極限變形——開！！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, the yellow cardboard bulldozer truck Xiaoji charges forward at full speed from the left, its six black wheels spinning fast and throwing up gravel. Giant Dahei swings one huge clawed arm down, and the truck's wide yellow front blade slams straight into Dahei's leg armor, bursting with bright orange sparks and flying black armor chips as Dahei staggers back.
shots.camera: The camera holds a wide low-angle action shot.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, giant Dahei bends down and grabs the front blade of the yellow cardboard bulldozer truck with its huge dark hand, lifts the six-wheeled truck off the ground and hurls it high into the air to the upper left. The yellow cardboard truck flies upward with its six wheels spinning while rocks and purple sparks scatter below as Dahei roars.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static wide low-angle shot.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Xiaoji lies face down on the wet ground with its eyes dark. Its eyes flicker weakly, it groans and slowly presses both cardboard hands against the ground. Trembling, it pushes its upper body up, gasping between words, its head lifting toward the off-screen giant, eyes widening in shock as they glow orange again. A thin trail of smoke rises from its dented back.
shots.camera: The camera slowly pushes in at ground level.

line.text: 呃……可惡！他的力量……還在暴漲？！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teacher Huang and the four pupils quickly sort recycling: the children toss plastic bottles into the blue bin, flatten cardboard and stack it, and the teacher hands a box to a boy. As each item lands in the right bin, streams of golden sparkling light rise from the bins and spiral through the air toward the distant yellow robot in the background. The children look up at the golden light with amazement.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static wide shot on a tripod.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, golden light streams and flying bottles and cardboard pieces swirl around Xiaoji and sink into its body. Its whole cardboard body begins to glow brighter gold. Xiaoji struggles at first, then straightens up with growing determination, speaking the line from strained to powerful, and on the last words it thrusts its glowing right fist high toward the sky, its eyes blazing gold.
shots.camera: The camera slowly tilts up from a low angle.

line.text: 站起來……！朋友們……把力量借給我！

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, cracks of purple light split across Dahei's black armor. It clutches its chest as the purple core flickers and dies. Its armor blocks break apart and burst into countless sparkling white particles that drift away on the wind. The purple storm clouds pull apart, and bright blue sky and warm sunlight pour down over the school as the last glittering particles float away.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static wide shot on a tripod.

shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, under the festive red school banner, Teacher Huang raises both arms and announces the line with a big excited smile, looking straight at the camera. The four children jump up and down cheering and wave their arms. Xiaoji raises one arm and makes a V-sign with its other hand, its eyes glowing happily. Colorful pennant flags flutter in the breeze above them.
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot on a tripod.

line.text: 12月5日星期六，後庄國小校慶見！

music.caption:
Genre: Heroic animated family adventure film score, bright orchestral superhero theme, driving drums, playful woodwinds, tense battle middle section, triumphant brass finale. BPM 128.
Vocal: NONE. No singing, no choir.
Arrangement: brass fanfares, staccato strings, taiko and orchestral percussion, glockenspiel sparkles.
